title: Document names a non-default port the endpoint does not use
rationale: Default ports are normalised away on both sides, so only a real port difference reaches this relation. Its conforming twin is `c12-conforming-explicit-default-port`; a single implementation that confused the two would flip both fixtures at once.

spec.quote: The `resource` value returned MUST be identical to the protected resource's resource identifier value into which the well-known URI path suffix was inserted to create the URL used to retrieve the metadata. If these values are not identical, the data contained in the response MUST NOT be used.
the following four URIs are equivalent: http://example.com http://example.com/ http://example.com:/ http://example.com:80/

documents.comment: everything but the `resource` value is conforming
conforming, so only C12 is under test
